newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-SPARE CAR BOOSTS HILL'S TITLE BID.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-SPARE CAR BOOSTS HILL'S TITLE BID.

text.p: Williams plan to send an extra car to the season-ending Japanese Grand Prix next weekend to ensure that the world championship showdown between Damon Hill and Jacques Villeneuve is a fair fight.
For all but two races this season the team have had just one spare car on stand-by. The two drivers have taken it in turns to have it set up their way.
Villeneuve, nine points behind Hill in the title duel, was due to have access to the car at Suzuka. Now they will have one apiece.
A Williams spokeswoman said on Friday: "It is basically so both drivers have an equal chance in the championship. Obviously it's very important for both of them.

"With one car, if either had a problem, it would delay them because we have to change the car and because the car would not be set up exactly how they want. Now both guys have the extra advantage and won't have any worries."
